## Line 396

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/polygons.library.plato, line 396](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/polygons.library.plato#L396).

```plato

    // The two parallel bases plus one parallelogram per base edge, each of area
    // |edge x Offset|.
    SurfaceArea(p: Prism3D): Number
        => 2.0 * p.Base.Area
        + SumOf(p.Base.Points.Count.MapRange(i => p.Base.Points[i]
            .Between(p.Base.Points.AtModulo(i + 1)).Cross(p.Offset).Magnitude));
```

## Line 435

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/polygons.library.plato, line 435](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/polygons.library.plato#L435).

```plato

    // The base plus one triangle per base edge, each spanned by that edge and the
    // Apex.
    SurfaceArea(y: Pyramid3D): Number
        => y.Base.Area
        + SumOf(y.Base.Points.Count.MapRange(i => 0.5 * y.Base.Points[i]
            .Between(y.Base.Points.AtModulo(i + 1))
            .Cross(y.Base.Points[i].Between(y.Apex)).Magnitude));
```
